name: dEchorate
description: This paper presents dEchorate: a new database of measured multichannel Room Impulse Responses (RIRs) including annotations of early echo timings and 3D positions of microphones, real sources and image sources under different wall configurations in a cuboid room. These data provide a tool for benchmarking recent methods in echo-aware speech enhancement, room geometry estimation, RIR estimation, acoustic echo retrieval, microphone calibration, echo labeling and reflectors estimation. The database is accompanied with software utilities to easily access, manipulate and visualize the data as well as baseline methods for echo-related tasks.
reputation: A specialized audio/room-acoustics dataset that is used in research on echo-aware speech processing and acoustic scene estimation rather than as a broad general-purpose benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark with measured multichannel RIRs and annotations; evaluation is task-dependent and often uses estimation error metrics rather than a single unified score.
